name: Wikipedia Concepts Semantic Relatedness Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset of concept pairs (from Wikipedia) with relatedness judgments to evaluate algorithms that compute semantic relatedness between concepts.
reputation: Moderately used benchmark in semantic relatedness research, especially for evaluating distributional and knowledge-based similarity measures.
notes: Moderate size; potential training-data contamination for models trained on Wikipedia; evaluated via correlation metrics and can saturate for strong pretrained models.
